name: Metro LeCrown Government Certification Tracker
summary: Central workspace for Metro LeCrown government certification readiness, buyer portal requirements, reusable document tracking, and capability statement drafts.
highlights: Certification tracker now covers federal, state, local, university, transit, school district, and TDCJ buyer gates.
Reusable document requirements are mapped across certifications and target buyers.
Capability statement drafts exist for the master profile, City of Houston, Houston METRO, UH/UT, and TDCJ.
Sensitive documents are tracked by storage location and owner instead of exposing private contents or public URLs.

timeline.title: Certification tracker created
timeline.description: Local tracker, certification steps, buyer requirements, reusable documents, and evidence register were created in metroLecrown.

timeline.title: Document portal layer added
timeline.description: Tracker was extended with portal storage locations, document-to-portal mapping, and capability statement tracking.

timeline.title: Portal workspace payload prepared
timeline.description: Project payload and upload manifest were prepared for the LeCrown client portal.

preview.notes: Use this workspace as the operating dashboard for certification progress, document gaps, and capability statement drafts.
